text:
Fee day should not mean a queue at the school office.

India's private unaided schools now teach 9.89 crore students, up from 9 crore two years earlier (Ministry of Education UDISE+ 2025-26 report, as reported by PTI). More students means more fees to raise, collect and follow up.

A simple fee day checklist for school offices:
• Raise the month's fees for every class before fee day, not on the counter.
• Give a numbered receipt for every payment, whatever the mode: UPI, cash, cheque or bank.
• Settle the oldest dues first, so the dues list stays honest.
• Check one defaulters list every week instead of calling every parent.
• Send a polite reminder the same day a fee goes overdue.
